description: Docker packages programs and their needed files into images. Containers run from those images. We will inspect small examples and practise only on a local learning machine. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.

seo.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Docker with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
